candidates.title: Civitai prompt 149765640
candidates.prompt:
An unsigned 1920s Art Deco oil portrait on canvas, painted by hand rather than photographed, in the polished machine-age manner of 1929. The paint is smooth as enamel with no visible brushwork, and every form is built from hard-edged geometric planes: her face and body are sculpted volumes with crisp borders between lit and shadowed planes, cloth breaks into sharp angular folds, and hair sets in hard sculpted waves. Skin, satin and metal share one cool metallic sheen. Her face and body keep natural adult proportions. The palette is steel grey, gunmetal blue, black and white, plus one accent colour. She is the only person in the picture, in hard, clear daylight under a steel-grey sky broken into angular planes, and every surface around her is polished: chrome flashes white and satin gleams in long sharp highlights.

Scale: The roadster is a full-size open two-seat motor car of 1929, painted deep emerald green, its long bonnet as long as she is tall and each spoked wheel as high as her hip, with a plain unbadged chrome radiator grille and long sweeping mudguards.

Depth: The car stands side-on across the frame, its front wheel at the left and its rear wheel at the right. She sits on the bonnet in front of the windscreen, nearest the view, and the angular sky is behind both.

Framing: Eye level, a landscape frame at the height of the bonnet, a few paces off.

Pose: She is sitting in a yokozuwari side-sit.

Sitting on the bonnet is a 34-year-old French woman with short black hair in a sharp sculpted bob, side-parted and swept off her forehead, and fair skin. She has a long, fully adult face with high cheekbones, a firm jaw, a straight nose, heavy-lidded grey eyes and dark crimson lipstick. Her build is mature: rounded shoulders, full breasts, a narrow waist, wide hips and long, strong legs. She wears a white bias-cut satin slip dress, one strap fallen off her shoulder and the hem ridden up to show the tops of sheer stockings. Her gaze is turned past the left edge, down the road.

Posture and light: Her hand on the left side of the picture is planted on the green bonnet beside her hip, and her hand on the right side of the picture rests on the chrome frame of the windscreen behind her. The satin is creased in sharp angular folds across her hip, and the chrome trim flashes white along the bonnet. The canvas is filled to every edge, and its corners are clean sky or polished surface.
